# Frankie 1.1.14
- Adds **Take Over Current Task** to the menu bar and Frankie menu, with Command-Shift-T as a shortcut. - Frankie reads the active app, proposes the objective and next steps, and waits for confirmation before taking control. - Screen content is treated as evidence, not instructions. Frankie will not infer permission to send, publish, buy, delete, approve, or change security settings.

## What's new
- New Permissions window (menu bar → Permissions…) showing everything Frankie can use — Microphone, Screen Recording, Accessibility, Messages sending, and Full Disk Access — each with live status and a Grant access button. - Full Disk Access (needed for reading Messages history) never gets a macOS prompt, so its button takes you straight to the right System Settings pane; status flips live once you switch it on. - Statuses refresh every couple of seconds while the window is open, so granting in System Settings shows up immediately.

## What's new
- Computer Runs can now be sized to the job: Frankie picks a step and time budget per run (up to 200 steps or 45 minutes, defaults unchanged at 40 steps / 8 minutes), and the approval message always states the limits you're agreeing to. - Ask for several things at once: multiple approved runs queue on this Mac and execute one after another, each posting its own result back to chat. A run you start locally keeps priority. - Runs that stop reporting (for example if the Mac sleeps or Frankie quits mid-run) are now failed cleanly on the server so chat is told instead of waiting forever.
